title: FUNCTIONAL EMRSs
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Tribal Affairs

FUNCTIONAL EMRSs

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
13 AUG 2026 2:20PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed today in Lok Sabha that as on date, 508 Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs) are functional across the country. State and UT-wise status of functional EMRSs is given at
Annexure.

In the State of Odisha, 114 EMRSs have been sanctioned out of which 47 EMRSs are functional. None of the blocks in Dhenkanal and Angul districts fulfil the prescribed criteria for establishing EMRS as per existing scheme guidelines.

Annexure

Annexure as referred in part (a) to (b) of the reply to Lok Sabha Unstarred question No. †4345 for 13.08.2026 raised by
